hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Reset the count "turnInCurrState".
Call arg.

Count up "turnInCurrState".
Let ability be the id of the move labelled "fight_back_guard" on the enemy.
If the enemy is ready to act, then
  If run helper, then the enemy uses ability.
  Otherwise, the enemy picks and uses a smart-weighted move.

script_hooks.logic:
Let aiArg be the battle settings of the group of the enemy.
Let v be the count "turnInCurrState".
Let number be the numeric entry "first_turns_of_fight_back" in aiArg.
Let number2 be the numeric entry "every_turns_of_fight_back" in aiArg.
Let v2 be call game:ai.AiUtil.isThereEnableAbilityTarget with (the enemy, {abilityTag: "fight_back_guard"}).
Return not (v is less than number) and (if v is number then v2 else (v minus number) mod number2 equals 0 and v2).
